commercial_product.name: HeartBeam AIMIGo
commercial_product.modality: Credit-card-sized, cable-free portable 3-lead ECG recorder with 12-lead synthesis software
commercial_product.indication: Recording, storage, and transfer of patient ECG for physician interpretation; rhythm assessment

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: HeartBeam is a cardiac monitoring medical-device company. Its only product is the FDA-cleared AIMIGo portable ECG device. No proprietary drug pipeline; ClinicalTrials.gov hits are device validation studies, not Phase 1/2/3 drug trials.
